_comment: The proof policy a merge gate enforces: `stepstitch proof verify fixproof.json --policy proof-policy.json --head-sha <PR head>`. Every requirement here is checked OFFLINE against the proof document alone. require_grade 'measured' means StepStitch itself ran the frozen reproduction red-then-green; an outcome a CI job merely asserted never passes this floor. require_signature stays false until you configure STEPSTITCH_SIGNING_KEY — flip it once your host signs with your own key.
